alignments.note: Postpositive δέ realized by the verse-initial *Now*.
Subject pronoun to *ye*; the copula is expressed in the Greek, so nothing is supplied for it to carry.
Anarthrous predicate noun with a supplied determiner, its rule 7 helper under rule 51.
Genitive name rendered *of Christ*, head on the name.
ἐκ μέρους rendered by the single *severally*, which answers to neither token separately; one noncompositional unit headed on the governed noun under rule 45, as καθ᾿ ἕνα → *severally* is.
Noun to *members*, the supplied *thereof* completing its English expression as a rule 7 helper.

review_notes: ἐκ μέρους is read as noncompositional on rule 45's single-English-word test; the ASV's marginal *members each in his part* would spread it over separate words, but the text does not.
